name: Tool — Fabric IQ (1P MCP)
description: Fabric IQ would expose Microsoft Fabric knowledge through a first-party MCP-style tool attached to a Prompt Agent. The host agent's orchestrator model would be BYOM-routed, but the Fabric IQ tool itself is a separate first-party data source.
notes:
Not supported by the documented BYOM tool matrix; no meaningful probe is possible until Microsoft publishes the Fabric IQ endpoint URL. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/tools/fabric-iq. See `test.py` for the placeholder.

Fabric IQ is not on the official BYOM-supported tools list; only Foundry IQ, SharePoint Grounding, and Fabric Data Agent are listed as 1P MCP servers. Official list: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations.
